page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 32 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 32 vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A defining characteristic of this server is its massive bundled local storage, consisting of 94,489 GB of HDD capacity.

Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The absence of GPU hardware and the reliance on high-capacity HDD storage instead of SSDs indicates a design optimized for high-density, sequential storage workloads rather than high-IOPS database operations or parallelized acceleration. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the massive storage-to-resource density makes it highly suitable for large-scale data archiving, distributed file systems, and cold storage workloads where capacity per unit of compute is prioritized over storage speed.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 server instance designed for storage-heavy workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, it features 32 dedicated physical cores (32 vCPUs) and 128.0 GB of RAM. The standout feature of this KVM-based instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 94,489 GB of HDD storage. With a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and no GPU acceleration, this server is optimized for high-capacity data storage and processing. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio provides balanced compute and memory, while the massive HDD capacity makes it highly cost-efficient for large-scale sequential data access, distributed file systems, and data archiving.
